title: Short stack: Browser → BFF → Harness → Daytona
description:
Current Daytona path bakes the full lanyard-agent source+dist tarball into the snapshot at /opt/company-brain-backend/current/lanyard-agent/. The gateway process and model API calls run inside the guest. File tools are vault-scoped but MockLab kitchen-sink leaves bash ungated, so the instance can read and possibly rewrite product source. Documented in README.md (How Lanyard Agent sits on the sandbox).

Desired split (operator intent): agent-core / harness stays off the user-writable sandbox. Sandbox receives tool work (files, shell, browser) the way ChatGPT Code Interpreter, Claude.ai code execution, Perplexity Computer/SPACE, and xAI API code execution do. Closest published migration: Anthropic Cowork moved the agent loop out of the VM and left only code execution in the guest (https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/how-we-contain-claude).

This bead is design + implementation tracking. Do not treat the README comparison as a locked target architecture until a plan is written.

Acceptance:
- Design note under docs/plans (or ADR) stating where the loop, tools, and product tree live
- Guest image no longer ships agent-core TypeScript source as a readable working tree (dist-only or harness-outside)
- Sandbox cannot persist edits to the product install across tenants
design:
Locked 2026-08-14 (GH #450 discussion):

- Chat hot path: Browser → BFF → Harness → Daytona toolbox. Relay off the *target* path; stays for guest dual-run.
- Harness = Lanyard Agent repo (external LA host), not a new Portal package.
- Sandbox cardinality: one Daytona box per concurrent user (not per chat, not per tenant). Tenant instance remains 0010's choice of *which* box; short stack does not invent per-chat compute.
- Dual-run: short stack is a *new* path. Do not rewrite today's guest-gateway snapshot to become the harness.
- 0010 (lp-zoh) owns which sandbox/vault a user gets. Short stack owns where the agent loop runs.
- Step 5 (tool bind) implements ensure_online(tenant, user) so it can sit on 0010 later.

Open (need pick after explanation):

- BFF↔Harness wire: HTTP+SSE (pass-through of existing Relay event shapes) vs gRPC/Connect. Recommendation: HTTP first; gRPC only if vault/Office bytes go through the harness.
- Vault/Office UI: harness Brain RPC vs BFF→CP/S3. Recommendation: BFF→S3 for Directory/Office so chat cutover is not blocked on LA Brain RPC or a warm sandbox. Agent file tools still use Daytona toolbox on the user sandbox.

Non-goals unchanged: per-chat boxes, merge BFF+Harness, rewrite Portal web, delete CP, cron harness.
